executive_summary: lib/testing/vision-qa-agent.js's autoSelectModel() hardcoded 9 literal Gemini model-string returns ('gemini-2.5-flash' x7, 'gemini-2.5-pro' x2) that bypassed the single SSOT for Gemini model selection, lib/config/model-config.js's getGoogleModel(purpose). This SD (child D of the SD-LEO-ORCH-GEMINI-MODEL-SCAN-001 8-child campaign) resolves all 9 literals to getGoogleModel('vision')/getGoogleModel('reasoning') calls, byte-identical in effective model today (MODEL_DEFAULTS.google.vision='gemini-2.5-flash', .reasoning='gemini-2.5-pro') but now env-overridable and centrally upgradable like every other purpose-keyed caller in the codebase. Verified via gemini-pin-lint.mjs (9 violations -> 0) and 12/12 branch-parity checks against the pre-fix commit.

technical_requirements.title: Windows execSync git-ref gotcha for verification scripts
technical_requirements.description: Any verification script comparing pre-fix vs post-fix content via git show must use <sha>~1:<path> rather than <sha>^:<path> -- on Windows, cmd.exe's execSync degrades '^' silently, producing a false pre-fix==post-fix match.
